Description: MSX cartridge edge connector, 50 pins (2 x 25), 2.54 mm pitch, part of the board
EEPROM 32 KB (AT28C256 or compatible), flashed with rom/XIOROM.hex
Resistor network 8 x 4.7 kOhm, common pin, SIL9
Slide or toggle switch 1 x changeover: write enable of the EEPROM
LED 3 mm with built-in resistor for 5 V, green (LED101 MSX powered, LED102 switched IO enabled)
LED 3 mm with built-in resistor for 5 V, yellow (interrupts enabled)
Box header 34 pins (2 x 17), 2.54 mm, for the ribbon cable to the RC2014 adapter
